personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with Glass/Luxe elevated moments for live matches
personality_one_liner: An elegant, clean, and prestigious football simulator celebrating the Italian style with azure and gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical spacing, 16px screen padding, native rhythmic spacing for lists. Avoid dense dashboard grids unless strictly showing the standings table.

do's: Use glassmorphism for the sticky match ticker during the 90-second live simulation
Use glassmorphism for the bottom tab bar
Use glassmorphism for sticky header of the Championship Standings table
dont's: Never blur standard player list rows or settings forms
Do not blur the background of team creation cards

screens.name: Dashboard / Home
screens.purpose: Overview of the active league, upcoming matchday, and quick access to next actions.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Crea la tua prima squadra' (Create your first team) CTA.
states.error: Failed to load league data. Retry.

screens.layout: Hero image of a stadium overlaid with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Below it, a clean summary card of the active league, showing the top 3 standings in a minimalist table layout, and a prominent 'Next Matchday' card.

screens.name: Team & Roster Management
screens.purpose: CRUD interface for the 12-20 teams and up to 20 players per team.

states.empty: No teams created. Large 'Add Team' CTA.

screens.layout: A two-column grid of team cards (showing team name, global strength 1-100, and a generated badge/initials on a brandTertiary circle). Tapping a team opens a detail view with a list of players. Player creation uses native sliders for Forza Gol, Assist, and Fallosità (1-30).

screens.name: Live Simulation & Matches
screens.purpose: View matchday fixtures, start instant simulation, or watch the 90-second live viewer.

states.empty: No fixtures available (Season over or not generated).

screens.layout: List of fixtures for the current matchday. A sticky bottom CTA to 'Avvia Simulazione' (Start Simulation). When live simulation starts, a modal or dedicated screen opens with a sticky 90-second clock (Space Grotesk font) at the top. Matches are displayed in a list of live score tickers updating in real-time. Goals and cards appear with a subtle animation and haptic feedback.

screens.name: Match Detail
screens.purpose: View the timeline and statistics of a completed or live match.
screens.layout: A header showing the final score. Below it, a chronological timeline (using dividers and small icons) of goals (⚽), assists, and cards (🟨/🟥) with exact minutes. Player names and minutes are cleanly aligned.

screens.name: Rankings (Classifiche)
screens.purpose: Segmented control between General Table, Top Scorers, and Top Assists.

states.empty: No data yet. Play a match to see standings.

screens.layout: Sticky header with glassmorphism containing a segmented control. The General Table uses a tight list layout (Pos, Team, Pts, W, D, L, GD). The Top Scorers/Assists views use a standard list with player name, team name (muted), and the stat prominent on the right.

empty_state_texture.alt: Abstract blue and gold texture for empty state backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Design an Italian-style football simulation app emphasizing a clean, elegant aesthetic (iOS-Native Clean) using an 'azzurrino e oro' (azure and gold) palette as the user explicitly requested.
Implement local device storage (AsyncStorage/Zustand persist) for all state (Teams, Players, League progress, Matches) since no login is required.

For the Live Simulation Viewer (90-second realtime feature): Build a robust interval-based timer where 1 second = 1 minute. Ensure all matches update parallelly. Trigger haptic feedback (`goal_scored` heavy impact) when a goal occurs.

In Team Roster Management: Player attributes (Forza Gol, Percentuale Assist, Fattore Fallosità) scale from 1 to 30. Use native sliding components (`@react-native-community/slider` or similar) for an intuitive input experience.
Match Detail Timeline: Structure the timeline chronologically with exact minutes for goals, assists, and cards. Use clear, distinct icons (Soccer ball for goal, colored squares for cards).

League Table (Classifica): Ensure horizontal scanning is clean. Use sticky headers for table columns (Pos, Squadra, PT, G, V, N, P, DR). Use `Space Grotesk` or the configured mono-like display font for tabular numbers so scores and points align perfectly.
Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient, vertical, transparent to surfaceInverse) strictly on the Hero stadium image to guarantee white text readability.
Language selection (IT/EN) should be globally available and immediately re-render strings (using i18n-js or simple context).
